fig6_1_funding_pct_gdp.svg: Two charts, 2028-29 to 2045-46, per cent of GDP, on P*'s central path with no dividend. Panel A: the five taxes raise 1.24% of GDP in 2028-29 against P*'s net cost of 1.86%, rise above it to a peak of 2.15% in 2030-31, fall below it from 2037-38, and end at 1.50% against 1.71% in 2045-46. Panel B: A$20.7 billion is borrowed in 2028-29 (0.62% of GDP) and repaid by 30 June 2032; surpluses kept peak at A$44.9 billion at 30 June 2038 and are used up by 2043-44, when a levy starts, reaching 0.62% of market income (0.22% of GDP) in 2045-46.
fig6_2_ai_fund.svg: Line chart, 2028-29 to 2045-46, A$ billion a year, run on the 22 October design. AI receipts rise from about A$27 billion to A$124 billion on the Productivity Commission path, to A$255 billion at 2.0% productivity growth and to A$515 billion at 3.0%. The cost of the step from a payment at the JobSeeker rate to one at the Age Pension rate rises from A$205 billion in 2037-38 to A$295 billion in 2045-46, above the receipts on the two lower paths.
fig6_3_ucb_netdebt.svg: Two charts, 2028-29 to 2045-46, per cent of GDP against the Budget baseline, on P*'s central path with no fund. Panel A: the underlying cash balance is 0.62% of GDP worse than baseline in 2028-29, better in each year from 2029-30 to 2037-38, worse in 7 of the 18 years in all, and level with baseline once the levy starts. Panel B: net debt is 0.62% of GDP above baseline at 30 June 2029, falls below baseline from 2031-32, is furthest below it, by 0.87% of GDP, at 30 June 2038, and returns to baseline by 2043-44; net financial worth moves the opposite way.
fig7_1_roadmap.svg: Timeline in two panels with seventeen numbered gates. Panel A, November 2026 to June 2028: inquiry and consultation to September 2027, legislation passed by 31 December 2027, then build and test, with Stage 1 (P*) starting on 1 July 2028. Panel B, July 2028 to 2045-46: Stage 1 runs throughout; the randomised trial runs from July 2029 to June 2031 with results by December 2031; the AI need test is reported quarterly until the pathway's tests lapse on 30 June 2043 unless renewed; the PBO certifies the five taxes every year from 2029-30. A dashed, unscheduled row shows that any universal payment needs a later Act, not before 1 July 2032 and only after the need test, the trial and the PBO certificate are all met.
